name: personal-ai-intelligence-tool
description: Sipply — Full-stack AI news aggregator. Next.js + FastAPI + PostgreSQL. 11-stage daily pipeline: ingest → ML score → cluster → LLM summarize → email digest. TF-IDF scorer (Pearson r=0.75), bilingual EN/ZH. Deployed on Railway + Vercel.

paragraphs: Sip AI News Simply. A bilingual AI news brief and a trend radar of what the AI community is discussing, built and run end to end by one person.
www.sipply.dev · Trend Radar · Archive · Weekly recaps

Four times a day a pipeline reads 11 AI news feeds and 7 community platforms, scores and groups the articles into stories, writes a summary of each for three kinds of reader, translates everything into Chinese, and updates a Trend Radar of the topics people are talking about. Nobody touches it between runs.
features: A trained scorer instead of LLM calls. A TF-IDF + Ridge model trained on 422 GPT-labelled articles predicts audience fit, practical relevance and novelty (Pearson r up to 0.75). Scoring costs nothing per run and scales…

An unattended production pipeline. Ingest, filter, score, cluster, track status, merge stories across days, summarize, translate, then the Trend Radar stages. Each stage is timed and isolated, and a failure emails the…

A Trend Radar. Signals from Hacker News, Google News, YouTube, Bluesky, GitHub, DEV and Lobsters are grouped into topics, scored, placed by evidence and momentum, summarized, and linked to Sipply's story on each topic…

Readable by AI assistants (GEO). Every page ships its content in the server HTML with JSON-LD, and new pages are pushed to search engines through IndexNow after each run. A smoke test in CI reads the built site the way…
A fine-tuned small model. Qwen2.5-1.5B with LoRA on 780 distilled GPT-4o-mini examples (ROUGE-L 0.37), a path off the paid API.
